claims.text: Zen12 Premium seller lists 12 levels
claims.allowed: The seller lists 12 levels.
claims.not_allowed: We tested twelve levels.

claims.text: Zen12 Premium seller lists 48 downloadable MP3 tracks
claims.allowed: The seller lists 48 MP3 tracks.
claims.not_allowed: We reviewed and tested all tracks.

claims.text: Four listening styles per level: guided, music, nature, white noise
claims.allowed: The seller describes four styles.
claims.not_allowed: These four styles work for everyone.

claims.text: Seller lists quick-start guide, manual, audio level guides and support
claims.allowed: The seller's listing includes materials and support.
claims.not_allowed: FV verified all deliverables and support response.

claims.text: Premium displayed $87.99 on 2026-11-06
claims.allowed: The public seller page displayed $87.99 on Nov. 6; verify final checkout price.
claims.not_allowed: Your total today is $87.99.

claims.text: One-year money-back guarantee
claims.allowed: The seller advertises a one-year guarantee; FV has not tested refunds.
claims.not_allowed: Risk-free purchase with guaranteed easy refunds.

claims.text: 12 minutes equals one hour of advanced meditation
claims.allowed: The seller makes this claim; FV has not independently verified it.
claims.not_allowed: Get an hour of meditation in 12 minutes.

claims.text: Brainwave entrainment always causes deep meditation
claims.allowed: The seller discusses brainwave entrainment.
claims.not_allowed: Zen12 automatically puts your brain in a deep meditative state.

claims.text: Zen12 treats anxiety and guarantees better focus
claims.allowed: No verified product-specific medical or focus outcomes.
claims.not_allowed: Treat your anxiety or attention disorder with Zen12.

claims.text: Downloadable format may suit buyers wanting routine structure
claims.allowed: An organized audio library may suit people who prefer a guided routine.
claims.not_allowed: You will stick with it and achieve results.

claims.text: Coué describes twenty knots and morning/evening repetition
claims.allowed: Coué prescribed this practice.
claims.not_allowed: Coué scientifically proved it cures illness.

claims.text: Coué's medical claims demonstrate efficacy
claims.allowed: The historical author claimed disease improvement.
claims.not_allowed: Repeating this phrase heals organs.

claims.text: Suggestion can reduce Stroop interference in selected participants
claims.allowed: Raz and colleagues reported reduced Stroop interference in a selected sample.
claims.not_allowed: All listeners can eliminate distraction.

claims.text: Clinical hypnosis research validates Zen12
claims.allowed: Clinical hypnosis reviews concern varied studied interventions, not Zen12.
claims.not_allowed: Clinical science proves Zen12 works.

claims.text: FV approved as affiliate
claims.allowed: Public Inspire3 program exists; FV acceptance not established.
claims.not_allowed: FV is an approved Inspire3 affiliate.

claims.text: FV authorized affiliate tracking URL and payout terms
claims.allowed: No FV-specific earning URL or channel approval verified.
claims.not_allowed: Use any direct merchant URL to earn.

claims.text: Emails from awesome@inspire3.com establish publisher acceptance
claims.allowed: General marketing messages are not proof of publisher acceptance.
claims.not_allowed: An Inspire3 promotional email is approval.

claims.text: Disclosure only on general policy page suffices
claims.allowed: Place plain commission notice immediately beside future earning CTA.
claims.not_allowed: Hide disclosure in footer.

claims.text: Original optional 42s concept is a working video
claims.allowed: Original static poster and timed transcript only.
claims.not_allowed: The landing page features a finished video.

claims.text: Clicks are sales, signups are purchases
claims.allowed: Track separate landing, CTA, confirmed lead, partner-confirmed commission and actual settlements.
claims.not_allowed: Affiliate outbound click = earned revenue.

claims.text: Payhip owned Mind product is current and sellable
claims.allowed: Commerce must verify SKU, rights, total price, checkout and fulfillment before selecting a paid FV product.
claims.not_allowed: An FV Mind product is available for purchase.

claims.text: Grok campaign IDs and published URLs exist
claims.allowed: Map proposed topics; await immutable asset IDs and creator approval.
claims.not_allowed: This experiment drove traffic.

claims.text: Lead capture uses existing Focus single list
claims.allowed: Route visitors to the existing Focus page.
claims.not_allowed: Every click confirms a delivered subscriber.

All pricing is seller page snapshot, not checked-out verified amount.
